response.sql: WITH per_transaction_avg AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) as trans_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY transref), overall_avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as overall_avg FROM per_transaction_avg), kept_transactions AS (SELECT pta.transref, pta.trans_avg FROM per_transaction_avg pta CROSS JOIN overall_avg_cte oa WHERE pta.trans_avg > oa.overall_avg), kept_avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as kept_avg FROM kept_transactions) SELECT kt.transref, kt.trans_avg as average, kt.trans_avg - oa.overall_avg as above_overall, kt.trans_avg - ka.kept_avg as above_kept FROM kept_transactions kt CROSS JOIN overall_avg_cte oa CROSS JOIN kept_avg_cte ka ORDER BY above_kept DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
